notes.title: Discover Anima, the latest free game from Campus ADN!
1.12b - Even more bug fix!
notes.content:
Fixed an important issue where the stun ability wouldn't work.

The issue was found after the latest hotfix which was just released. But why wait for a bigger patch when it can be fixed right away? :D

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Improved stability in latest patch changes

notes.title: 1.12 - New controls / abilities teach method
notes.content:
The floating controls system was a temporary feature that did not work well enough. It has now been replaced with a better system to teach the abilities and controls and fits better with the backpack UI style.

The game is already in a much better state now. Enjoy :)

notes.title: 1.11 - Alpha Terminal Bug Fix
notes.content: -Fixed issue where the player would pass through the terminal, skipping the confirmation phase and tweaked some of its animations

notes.title: Patch 1.10 tweaks and fixes
notes.content:
-Fixed occlusion culling (models should not disappear anymore)
-Tweaked controls and avatar responsiveness
-Added backtrack possibility to level 9 and fixed some bugs
-Some sound fixes

notes.title: Day 1 Hotfix #2
notes.content:
-Fixed bug with one achievement
-Fixed sound issues
-Fixed issue with the Slayer's item drops
